name: Brevo (Sendinblue)
description: All-in-one platform for transactional email, SMS notifications, and marketing automation for overseas stores.
fullDescription: Brevo (formerly Sendinblue) provides reliable SMTP transactional email relay, multi-channel SMS notifications, and visual marketing automation workflows. It is especially favored by European and cross-border sellers due to strict GDPR compliance and cost-effective pricing based on email volume rather than contact list size.
features: High-deliverability transactional SMTP email relay and API webhooks
Multi-language customer communication with dynamic content blocks
Integrated SMS marketing and WhatsApp business messaging channels
Visual drag-and-drop workflow builder for lead nurturing and cart rescue
Full GDPR compliance with servers hosted inside the European Union
